name: Chicago Executive Airport

runway.v: longest runway 16/34, 5,001 ft x 150 ft (about 1,524 m), with ILS to runway 16; runway 12/30 is 4,415 ft x 75 ft
runway.quote: Runway 16/34 — 5,001-foot long by 150 foot wide precision runway served by an ILS to runway 16.

hours.v: airport open to the public 24 hours a day
hours.quote: KPWK – Open to the public 24 hours a day with two runway options

customs.v: CBP general aviation clearance 11:00-19:00 Monday to Friday, closed weekends; arrivals outside these hours must be arranged by 17:00 the business day before; clearance must be requested by speaking to the Duty Officer (APIS or voicemail is not enough)

noise.v: runway 12/30 preferred 22:00-06:00 local; no turbine engine runs 22:00-07:00; NBAA departure procedures
noise.quote: No turbine engine runs between the hours of 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. local time all week.

handling.v: three FBOs: Ascension Global Aviation, Atlantic Aviation and Signature Aviation
handling.quote: Ascension Global Aviation; Atlantic Aviation; Signature Aviation

max_aircraft.v: aircraft with a certificated maximum take-off weight over 98,000 lb need the Airport Manager's prior written permission to land or take off, except in an emergency
max_aircraft.quote: Aircraft with a certificated maximum gross takeoff weight in excess of 98,000 pounds shall not land or takeoff

fuel.v: the airport's minimum standards require each full-service FBO to deliver jet fuel and avgas on request, 7 days a week including holidays 06:00-24:00 local, and on call after hours (response within 60 minutes)
fuel.quote: deliver and dispense, upon request, Jet Fuel, Avgas, and Aircraft lubricants

notes: Read the Chicago Executive Airport safety page (modified 15 Jul 2026), noise page (modified 29 Jan 2026) and the CBP port page 3983 (modified 19 Mar 2024). The CBP page labels the 11:00-19:00 hours 'CST' in one place and '(Eastern)' in another; recorded as local Central time per the 'CST' line, check with the port before relying on it. The CBP KPWK fact sheet (18 Dec 2025) https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2025-12/KPWK%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020251218.pdf could not be opened. The airport page says open 24 hours, but no source states there is no curfew, so curfew is left missing. A 2026 environmental assessment mentions decommissioning runway 6-24 (not read). Metres are my conversion (1 ft = 0.3048 m). IATA code left null: the official pages read show only the FAA identifier, not a stated IATA code. 1 Nov 2026: added the FBO list from the Chicago Executive Airport resources page (modified 29 Jan 2026; quote joins the three list items). The FAA Know Before You Go sheet (kpwk-faa-kbyg, undated) gives tower hours '0600L-2200L M-F, 0700L-2200L Sat/Sun' and says the airspace becomes Class E when the tower is closed; it does not mention a curfew. The CBP KPWK fact sheet (18 Dec 2025) was not found by search and is still not opened. Curfew, fuel, slots, PPR and max aircraft still missing. | 3 Nov 2026: read the airport's Rules and Regulations (dated 15 Sep 2006, sections 3.4.1, 3.15.4.1, 3.22.2.6; a later amendment may exist; the last 18,000 characters were not read), its U.S. Customs page and the noise page. The Customs page says 'local' for 11:00-19:00 Mon-Fri, which supports the existing reading against the CBP page's '(Eastern)', and adds airport user fees effective 1 May 2021 of USD 200 to 1,750 by weight class, plus a USD 600 off-hours and holiday surcharge; weekend clearance must be arranged by 17:00 Friday. The noise page says aircraft over 75,000 lb under Part 121, 125 or 135 may not be permitted to use the NBAA close-in departure procedure. Rules section 3.4.1 says the airport is available 24 hours unless closed by NOTAM, which does not state there is no curfew, so curfew stays missing.
